name: get-access
why: returns one object, the entity's access settings (`acl`, `permissionSources`, `parentEntities`)

name: get-permissions
why: returns one object with `READ`, `WRITE` and `GRANT` at its root

name: get-suggest
why: suggests issues by the text typed; the page's name says get

name: new-transition
why: moves the issue to another status; the page's name says new, and nothing is created

name: search-release
why: releases the scroll contexts of a search; it reads nothing, and the page's name says search
